title: ALMA Deep Field in SSA22: Source Catalog and Number Counts
question: What 1.1 mm sources and number counts does a deep contiguous ALMA mosaic reveal in the core of the z=3.09 SSA22 protocluster, and how do they relate to AzTEC sources and the protocluster?

what.value: AzTEC source IDs and flux densities
SMA 860um flux density of ADF22.1 (12.2+-2.3 mJy)

evidence.quote: Tamura et al. reported the 860$\mu$m flux density of ADF22.1, $S_{\rm 860\mu m}=12.2\pm2.3$ mJy

recipe.method: Combine uv data, clean with mosaic mode; tapered FULL/LORES map (fields 1-103) and untapered DEEP/HIRES map (fields 1-80)
rms per 0.1" pixel from surrounding 100x100 pixels on map before primary beam correction
Find positive sources above 3.5 sigma with aegean; negative sources counted to estimate spurious fraction; adopt >5 sigma
key_parameters: 5 sigma detection limit; 17 FULL/LORES + 1 DEEP/HIRES-only source

recipe.method: imfit Gaussian fits on primary-beam-corrected map; integrated flux adopted unless lower than peak
Inject model sources (scaled synthesized beam) at 0.02-0.6 mJy, re-extract, 1000 repeats per bin; recovery within 1" at >=4 sigma
Sum ALMA >=5 sigma fluxes within 30" AzTEC beam vs deboosted AzTEC flux; also convolve ALMA map with 30" Gaussian

recipe.goal: Measure sizes and SFR surface density
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fits on DEEP/HIRES map for SNR>10 sources; L_IR from SED templates; SFR via Kennicutt calibration (Kroupa IMF); Sigma_SFR with SFR/2
assumptions: z=3.0 for ADF22.2 and ADF22.5 lacking zspec

recipe.method: Differential and cumulative counts of 17 SMGs >5 sigma (FULL/LORES), completeness-corrected, and for 7 non-z=3.09 SMGs; cumulative field counts fit to a double power law with literature counts
assumptions: Literature counts scaled to 1.1 mm with modified blackbody beta=1.5, T=35 K, z=2.5

evidence.quote: Therefore in total 18 sources were detected at SNR$>5$.

answer_key.quantity: Median size of nine brightest SMGs (FWHM)

evidence.quote: the median value for the nine SMGs is $0^{\prime\prime}.32^{+0^{\prime\prime}.13}_{-0^{\prime\prime}.06}$
The median value is $\Sigma_{\rm SFR}$=50 $M_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$ kpc$^{-2}$
The completeness of our source extraction is $\sim70$% at SNR=4 and rises to $\sim90$% at SNR=5.

answer_key.quantity: Cumulative counts N(>0.40 mJy), all 17 SMGs

not_stated_but_needed: aegean detection parameters beyond the 3.5 sigma threshold
exact clean parameters (niter, cell, image size, mosaic gridder)
which SEDs templates and exact weights for L_IR
injected model source count per trial and details of the model profile
Poisson/completeness correction procedure details for number counts
missing_for_reproduction: Redshifts from unpublished works (Umehata et al., Hayatsu et al. in prep)
score_reason: Data identified and main steps described, but several imaging and extraction parameters and unpublished redshifts are missing.
rediscovery_reason: ALMA project code given, recipe largely described, results numeric (source catalog, counts, sizes).
